**All four breaks are fixed and measured, and the configuration is now a link you can send.**

![the hub at 3440](shots/hub-3440.png)

**The four breaks.** The bar left the stage: it is a sibling *above* it now, in flow, so it reserves its height — a real click on **Pricing** lands at 1280 and 3440, where it timed out at both before. The box reserves its height too ([reserved height](/imagine/paging/navigation/reserved/), lifted from nav-stability), so the caption reads *The box did not move: still 2739 x 371px* instead of sitting over *335px shorter*. A full-screen stage takes the screen and never the rail — [the takeover preset](/imagine/paging/library/takeover/) keeps the rail at every width and always has an exit. And the four intro strings that printed their own `**` go through `md()`.

**The configuration is in the url.** Click three chips and the address says so; copy it, open it cold, you get the same page. Proven: `/imagine/paging/?navigation=rail&content=dashboard&surface=dark`. The drawer has **Copy this link** and **the `page.js` this would be**, and the bar has a **Code** button beside **More**.

**One vocabulary, one schema.** `navigation` had five live definitions and `surface` five; [`blocks.js`](/imagine/paging/) is the one list now. Make writes the same seven words the drawer writes, and old nodes migrate on read. `navigation` and `arrangement` no longer both say *Left rail* — the arrangement pair is **Panel left / Panel right**. Skin has three urls at last: [`/skin/surface/`](/imagine/paging/skin/surface/), [`/skin/background/`](/imagine/paging/skin/background/), [`/skin/type/`](/imagine/paging/skin/type/).

**The hub is twelve live miniatures**, seven across at 3440. Its first screen was 58% bare grey; it is 32%, and the bare row beside the stage went 1785px to 90px. New: [Cross](/imagine/paging/cross/) — nine real pages, navigation across and arrangement down. 37 dead class names left `paging.css`; `axes:` and `width:` left 32 pages.

**Checked:** 25 pages x 400/1280/1920/3440 = 100 loads, **zero console errors**, no sideways scroll, no literal `**`, nothing with text at x:0.

**Left, with the order written down:** `BuildStage` should render a `PagingStage` — it needs one new `draw_child` seam first, and half a merge on the builder is worse than two renderers ([doc/builder.md](/imagine/paging/doc/builder/)). `/imagine/paging/readme/` logs one 404 for `readme/page.js` — core's own probe before the markdown fallback, by design.
